description: This PHP source file defines a class smpl_Contact_Sample that generates an HTML email template for contact information and company details, used for PDF generation within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: smpl_Contact_Sample
classes.description: A class responsible for generating an email template with contact and company information for PDF documents.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document or template, in this case 'Contacts'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content of the email template including dynamic logo URL, localized date, and contact details.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header content of the template; currently empty.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer content of the template; currently empty.
